page.overview:
Who is Allen?

Allen is an anthropomorphic rooster who appears in the Adventure Time comic book series. He wakes people up, much like real life roosters. He can fly, and he lives in the clouds. He has only been seen saying "Cock-A-Doodle-Doo", but on one occasion said "Cock-A-Doodle-NOO!"

In Issue 37, his first appearance, he is seen waking Finn and Jake up at the Tree Fort.

In Issue 41, Allen goes to wake up Peppermint Butler, but he is already awake, and Allen is dismissed.

In Issue 47, Allen is sleeping in the clouds but is suddenly awakened by a thought demon (a creature that says other peoples' thoughts). He is later rescued by Finn, Jake, and Gata.
